title: Travel Itinerary
description: The single structured contract between the conversational travel agent and the PDF engine. Stores CLEAN, human-readable content only: the engine owns all presentation (letter-spacing, uppercasing, non-breaking-space gaps, route-map drawing, label de-confliction, KeepTogether anti-overflow). Designed for variable day counts and optional sections.

doc_kind.description: Kind line, e.g. 'A Private Travel Itinerary'. Drives cover kicker + running header.

date_label.description: Human date, e.g. 'October 2026'. Shown on cover + running header.

nights.description: Total nights; feeds cover duration label.

days.description: Total days; must equal len(days[]) unless an intro/outro day is intentionally merged.

footer_note.description: Small grey note bottom-left of every body page.

output_filename.description: Base filename for the emitted PDF.

title.description: PDF document metadata title (defaults to region.title + ' — ' + doc_kind).

region.description: Destination identity shown on the cover and in the running header.

title.description: Big cover title, e.g. 'Pacific Northwest'. Engine uppercases.

subtitle.description: Secondary cover line, e.g. 'Washington & Oregon'. Engine letter-spaces.

waypoints.description: Ordered region waypoints joined with ' | ' under the cover band.

cover.description: Cover-page specifics not derivable from region/meta.

kicker.description: Top letter-spaced kicker. Defaults to meta.doc_kind.

duration_label.description: Centre line under the date. Defaults to '{nights} Nights · {days} Days'.

stats.description: 2–4 stat boxes on the cover (value + short label).

label.description: Short caption, e.g. 'States'. Engine uppercases; use \n for two lines.

summary.description: Summary page: intro + route map + trip-at-a-glance tiles + activity tags + highlight cards.

intro.description: One justified paragraph describing the route/arc. Plain prose.

label.description: Caption; use \n for two lines, e.g. 'TOTAL\nDISTANCE'. Engine uppercases.

activity_tags.description: Pill badges of trip activities. Wrap automatically.

planning.description: Optional Planning page. An ORDERED list of typed sections so trips can add/drop/reorder panels (flights, ground transport, lodging, advance bookings, or any custom info panel). Omit the whole object to skip the Planning page.

oneOf.description: Two-column label/value panel (flights, getting around, advance bookings, etc.).

label.description: Section label, e.g. 'Flights'. Engine letter-spaces + uppercases.

oneOf.description: Lodging per night: preferred neighbourhood(s) PLUS a few suggested properties to compare and the rationale — enough for the traveller to make an informed choice, not one prescriptive booking. No prices.

properties.description: Optional — a few suggested properties in that area (ideally 2–3), offered as options to compare rather than a single prescriptive pick. No prices. Each may carry a short reason.

name.description: Property name, e.g. 'Inn at the Market'.

reason.description: Optional short reason this property is suggested, e.g. 'over Pike Place, walk everywhere'.

notes.description: Overall rationale for the area + booking guidance, so the traveller can choose informedly.

map.description: Route map driven by real coordinates, rendered offline on bundled Natural Earth shapefiles in the project palette.

stops.description: Ordered stops; the gold route line connects them in order.

name.description: Stop name shown on the map, e.g. 'Seattle'.

sublabel.description: Small caption under the name, e.g. 'Night 1' or 'Depart PDX'.

label_offset.description: Optional MANUAL override of label placement when auto de-confliction is imperfect. Prefer leaving unset.

bbox.description: Optional [lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max] override. If omitted the engine auto-fits to the stops with padding.

legs.description: Optional drive-time/distance labels drawn on each route leg, in order. Length should be len(stops)-1. e.g. '≈ 3 h · 165 mi'. Omit to draw a plain route line.

annotations.description: Optional static labels drawn on the map (e.g. state names, a sound). Decorative.

days.description: One entry per day page. Variable length.

label.description: Day badge override, e.g. '5'. Defaults to the 1-based index.

title.description: Day title, e.g. 'Drive to Olympic Peninsula'. Engine uppercases.

subtitle.description: Right-aligned note in the day header, e.g. 'Seattle → Kalaloch Area'.

date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Not rendered; it lets the validator catch a restaurant scheduled on a day it is closed. Prefer this over 'weekday' when real dates are known.

weekday.description: Optional weekday, for a trip with no fixed dates. Not rendered; same purpose as 'date'. Ignored when 'date' is present.

time.description: Freeform time label, e.g. '8:00 AM' or 'AFTERNOON'.

where_to_eat.description: Optional teal dining block. Multiple rows of the same category are allowed (e.g. two COFFEE rows).

dining.description: Optional 'Where to Eat' reference page: every dining recommendation for the trip in one place, grouped by budget. This is the SHORTLIST, including alternates and backups; days[].where_to_eat is the chosen meal for a given day. Different jobs, so both exist. Seeing every pick together is what makes an imbalance (the same cuisine in three of four dinner slots) visible at a glance. Omit the whole object to skip the page.

heading.description: Page heading. Defaults to 'Where to Eat'.

groups.description: Budget bands, rendered in this order. Each group is kept whole on a page.

label.description: Budget band, e.g. 'Under $25' or 'Splurge'. Engine uppercases.

area.description: Neighbourhood or town, so it can be placed on the route.

cuisine.description: One cuisine per entry, e.g. 'Mexican', 'Thai', 'Coffee'. Drives the cuisine tally and the icon, so keep it consistent across entries: 'Mexican' and 'mexican' tally together, 'Tex-Mex' does not.

price.description: Finer than the group band, e.g. '$15-20pp'.

hours.description: Human-readable opening hours, e.g. 'Daily 11-9'. Do NOT put closures here -- use 'closed'.

closed.description: STRUCTURED closures, not prose. The single highest-value field here: it is what lets the validator catch a restaurant scheduled on a day it is shut. A real itinerary booked a headline dinner on the one night of the week the place was closed and nothing caught it. Requires a date or weekday on the day entries to be checkable.

why.description: One line: why this earns a slot. Without it the page is just a list.

packing.description: Optional Packing page. Omit to skip.

footnote.description: Centered grey note under the packing table.
